notes.title: V21
notes.notes:
V21
Just a small little update for the Unity backend and resolving reported bugs.

Also Added unified Update text and "More Games By" panel on main menu that will be in all my games going forward. If you click the panel it will open to the games page and then won't suggest that game again on this installation. Also allows me to push update text without a full game update in case of urgent issues.

(hotfix - resolved some absolutely headache inducing save files problems)

adamvision <3
